questions.q: To the assembly in which city is 1 Corinthians written?
questions.evidence: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth

questions.q: What had Paul heard was going on in the church at Corinth?
questions.evidence: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you

questions.q: What does Paul call the body of a believer?
options: A temple of the Holy Spirit
questions.evidence: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God

questions.q: On which night did the Lord Jesus take bread, Paul writes?
questions.evidence: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread

questions.q: The body is one, Paul says, but has many what?
questions.evidence: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body

questions.q: Of faith, hope, and love, which does Paul call the greatest?
questions.evidence: The greatest of these is love

questions.q: On which day was Christ raised, according to the Scriptures?
questions.evidence: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures

questions.q: "Death, where is your" what, Paul asks?
